page.title: Settings
page.description: Company profile, localization and contact details

profile.title: Company
profile.description: Your business details, shown to renters and on invoices.
profile.name: Company name
profile.legalNameHelp: Your registered business name, if it differs. Shown on invoices.
profile.taxIdHelp: VAT, EIN or other tax number. Shown on invoices.
profile.subdomainHelp: Your fleet site's address. It can't change, because links you've shared use it.
profile.aboutPlaceholder: Family-run rentals in Miami since 1998, with free airport pickup.
profile.aboutHelp: Shown on your fleet site. Up to {{max}} characters.

localization.title: Localization
localization.description: Where you operate, your local time, and the currency renters pay in.
localization.currencyLocked: Can't be changed once you have bookings, so their prices keep their currency.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: How renters reach you. Shown on invoices and receipts.

social.title: Social links
social.description: Links to your social profiles. Leave any you don’t use blank.

ownerOnly.title: Only the owner can change company settings
ownerOnly.description: Ask the account owner to update the company profile, contact details or social links.

images.title: Logo and banner
images.description: Shown at the top of your fleet site.
images.bannerHelp: A wide photo, 1600 px or more
images.drop: Drop an image here, or click to choose one
images.replaceHint: Click or drop an image to replace
images.invalidType: Use a JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or AVIF image.

style.title: Colors and headline
style.description: Your fleet site's colors, and the line over your banner.
style.headline: Headline
style.headlineHelp: Shown over your banner. Leave it blank to show your company name.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.note: Updates as you edit. This is how your fleet site will look to renters.

payments.sectionHelp: How renters pay you, and where the money goes.
payments.title: Payment processor
payments.description: Renters pay into your own Stripe account and Stripe pays out to your bank. Refunds, disputes and payouts are managed in your Stripe Dashboard.
payments.summary: Connect a Stripe account to take card payments and deposits from renters.

notice.unavailable: Stripe isn't configured on the server yet, so an account can't be connected. Add the Stripe keys to the API environment to switch this on.
notice.needsInfo: Stripe needs a few more details before it can turn on payments and payouts.
notice.pastDue: A deadline for some of Stripe's details has passed, so payments or payouts may be paused. Finish setup to restore them.
notice.inReview: Stripe is reviewing your details. Check back here, or use Check status.
notice.rejected: Stripe couldn't approve this account. Your Stripe Dashboard or Stripe support can tell you why.
notice.disconnected: Payments are off. Your Stripe account, balance and payouts are untouched; reconnect to take payments through it again.

payments.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can connect or finish setting up Stripe.

confirmDisconnect.title: Disconnect Stripe?
confirmDisconnect.description:
Veltrio will stop taking payments through this Stripe account.

The account stays yours, with its balance and payouts, and you can reconnect it at any time.

confirmNewAccount.title: Set up a different Stripe account?
confirmNewAccount.description:
You'll go to Stripe to set up a new account for Veltrio.

Your current account stays yours, with its balance and payouts, but Veltrio won't be able to reconnect it afterwards.
